item.title: Disney Names Disney Park Executive Josh D'Amaro As Its New CEO, Replacing Bob Iger
item.description: Disney has found its next CEO, with Bob Iger set to pass the reins to Disney Parks executive Josh D'Amaro, who has been part of the company since 1998.

item.title: Super Bowl 2026: Every Trailer You Can Expect To See During Sunday's Big Game
item.description: The Super Bowl takes place this weekend, and we're now sharing a breakdown of every Big Game TV spot you should expect to see when the Seattle Seahawks and New England Patriots square off.

item.title: Hulk Actor Mark Ruffalo Responds To Reports He's Been Fired By Disney Following Anti-Trump Comments
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day star Mark Ruffalo has responded to claims that Disney has fired him from his role as The Hulk following his recent anti-Trump and anti-ICE remarks.

item.title: WONDER MAN Is "The Cure To Superhero Fatigue" On Awesome New Poster
item.description: Marvel Studios has released a new poster and behind-the-scenes photos from Wonder Man, and the former is full of praise for the MCU's latest Disney+ TV series.

item.title: Mattel Studios Will Follow MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE With TONY THE TATTOOED MAN Movie
item.description: Following Barbie and Masters of the Universe, Mattel Studios' next movie will be what sounds like a very unique take on a 1990s action figure, Tony the Tattooed Man.

item.title: It's Godzilla And Kong vs. Titan X In MONARCH: LEGACY OF MONSTERS Season 2 Trailer
item.description: The latest trailer for Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Season 2 reveals that Lee Shaw will pit Godzilla and King Kong against the formidable Titan X, but can even they stop the behemoth?

item.title: THE FALL GUY Star Teresa Palmer Joins Prime Video's GOD OF WAR TV Series As Sif
item.description: Another huge addition has just been made to the cast of God of War, with Warm Bodies star Teresa Palmer set to take over the role of Sif from Emily Rose (Uncharted).
